I saved the date to the knowledge brain, under Thornbury Cloth Co.: the signed order form is due 21 December, logged as coming from Marcus. Then I replied to him in a thread under his message in #north-team.

I didn't find that date anywhere else. There are no shared files for Thornbury, and the brain had nothing on it. Its search was keyword-only, so something worded differently could have been missed. Nothing else needed doing, since he said no action was needed. A deadline like this counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so sharing it isn't restricted.
